name: signatures
description: Open-source agreement and e-signature workflows for Markdown and PDFs: local signing, provider evidence, CLI, MCP, and an HTTP surface over a local SQLite store at ~/.hasna/signatures/signatures.db. The server's active data backend is SQLite; PostgreSQL is declared as the forward-looking engine capability with an environment-gated live proof (pgTestGate).

serviceSurfaces.name: signatures-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The package root export is not generated from an OpenAPI document: the API surface is deferred (signatures-serve does not yet serve GET /ready, GET /version, a /v1 base path, or /openapi.json), so the SDK cannot claim a contract-bound supported status with generatedFrom.

serviceSurfaces.name: signatures-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: signatures-serve exposes a local /api surface only. It implements GET /health but not GET /ready, GET /version, a /v1 base path, or an OpenAPI document, so declaring the API supported would assert a topology the server does not have.

conformance.notes: storage.engines postgresql is validator-forced: the kit refuses a waivedStorageEngines waiver for a service-capable cli-with-store shipping signatures-serve (measured). The PostgreSQL backend is NOT implemented in this repo (no DATABASE_URL handling in src; src/db/pg-migrations.ts is imported by nothing) — the declaration and its pgTestGate are recorded in the census CONTRACTS_EXCEPTIONS entry and must be removed when the schema permits an honest waiver.
